# eslint-plugin-test-integrity

Guide for AI coding assistants using this plugin in a project. To change the plugin's own source, read https://github.com/ofri-peretz/eslint/blob/main/AGENTS.md instead.

> ESLint plugin for test integrity — no focused tests, no unexplained skips, no fixed sleeps, no retries; plus a pre-push check for weakened assertions and unexplained snapshot updates.

## Enable it

```bash
npm install --save-dev eslint-plugin-test-integrity
```

Requires ESLint ^8.40.0 || ^9.0.0 || ^10.0.0 and Node >=18.0.0.

Flat config files (`eslint.config.*`) are found by ESLint 8.57 and newer; on ESLint 9 and 10 they are the default.

```js
// eslint.config.mjs
import testIntegrity from 'eslint-plugin-test-integrity';

export default [testIntegrity.configs.recommended];
```

Each preset is one flat config object: put it in the array as an element, do not spread it. Rule ids are prefixed `test-integrity/`. Add it to the config you already have; do not remove other plugins. TypeScript files need a TypeScript parser in the config (`typescript-eslint`).

## Presets

| Preset        | Rules | Errors | Warnings |
| ------------- | ----- | ------ | -------- |
| `recommended` | 4     | 4      | 0        |
| `adoption`    | 4     | 0      | 4        |

### `recommended`

4 rules:

- `no-fixed-sleep` (error): Disallow fixed-duration sleeps in tests; await the event or condition instead.
- `no-focused-test` (error): Disallow focused tests (`.only`, `fit`, `fdescribe`) that silently turn the rest of the suite off.
- `no-test-retry` (error): Disallow test retries unless a comment cites the decision or issue that allows them.
- `no-unexplained-skip` (error): Require every skipped or todo test to carry an issue link, a decision id or an unexpired date.

### `adoption`

Same rules as `recommended`.
